control_failures.control_label: positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: kinetic release during transfer operations on HT-9002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 13 March 2011 an incident occurred on HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
